environment.transport: loopback HTTP + WebSocket; no network/CPU throttling
environment.build: App-local Vite production minified; VITE_PERFORMANCE_PROBE=true; Sentry disabled; static responses no-store

protocol.startup: fresh browser context → overview → equipment click handler (before navigation/lazy route loading) → history request through validation/state/chart; all first-load samples retained; excludes initial overview page navigation
protocol.steady: starts after first history frame and at least 3 streaming frame opportunities; 7 zoom/pan/focus/follow cycles per >=20s journey; soak has no chart inputs
protocol.timing: ECharts finished + two requestAnimationFrame callbacks: render-frame opportunity, NOT compositor/pixel presentation
protocol.p95: nearest rank; null when fewer than 20 samples; repeated stream samples within a run are not independent devices/users
protocol.eventTiming: native PerformanceEventTiming >=16ms (8ms rounding); sub-threshold inputs absent, not a production INP score
protocol.heap: performance.memory approximate Chromium-only used/total heap; sampled without forced GC; bounded observation cannot prove no leak
